settings.notifications.iosHint: On iPhone/iPad: install this app to the home screen first (Share → Add to Home Screen). Notifications only work after that.
settings.data.body: Your library and reading progress stay on this device (IndexedDB). Only your "following" list and push subscription are shared with the minimal server needed to notify you of releases.

settings.workerUrl.hint: Only needed to search Marvel/DC and for push notifications. Leave blank to use manga only.
